description: This source file defines serialization and copying codecs for nullable value types (Nullable<T>) within the Orleans framework. It includes a NullableCodec class for serialization/deserialization and a NullableCopier class for deep copying nullable types. The code utilizes attributes for serializer and copier registration, and employs helper methods for unwrapping services and handling references.

classes.name: NullableCodec<T>
classes.description: A serializer for nullable value types (Nullable<T>) implementing IFieldCodec<T?>. Handles null references and non-null values for serialization/deserialization.

classes.name: NullableCopier<T>
classes.description: A deep copier for nullable value types implementing IDeepCopier<T?>, allowing for optional deep copying of nullable types.

methods.name: NullableCodec(IFieldCodec<T> fieldCodec)
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the codec with a specific field codec for type T.

methods.name: WriteField(ref Writer<TBufferWriter> writer, uint fieldIdDelta, Type expectedType, T? value)
methods.description: Serializes a nullable value, writing null reference if value is null, otherwise serializing the underlying value.

methods.name: ReadValue(ref Reader<TInput> reader, Field field)
methods.description: Deserializes a nullable value, returning null if wire type indicates a reference null, otherwise reading the underlying value.

methods.name: ThrowInvalidReference(uint reference)
methods.description: Throws an exception if an invalid reference is encountered during deserialization.

methods.name: NullableCopier(IDeepCopier<T> copier)
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the copier with a specific deep copier for type T.

methods.name: IsShallowCopyable()
methods.description: Determines if the nullable type is shallow copyable based on the presence of an underlying copier.

methods.name: DeepCopy(object input, CopyContext context)
methods.description: Performs deep copy on an object, handling nulls and leveraging the underlying copier if available.

methods.name: DeepCopy(T? input, CopyContext context)
methods.description: Performs deep copy on a nullable value type, using the underlying copier if available.
